methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units by identifying individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two information sources.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Detect 1 to 0 transition on each bit of a 32-bit input vector
Circuit has a synchronous active-high reset input
Output bit should be set to 1 when corresponding input bit changes from 1 to 0
Output bit remains 1 until reset is asserted
spec_atomic_units: Module has synchronous reset input reset
Combinational logic detects 1-to-0 transition on each bit of input in
transition_detect_i is asserted if previous_in_i was 1 and current in_i is 0
reset signal resets all bits of out register to 0
32 instances of single-bit transition detection circuit operate in parallel
Output out is updated on the rising edge of clk
When reset is high, out is synchronously reset to 0
When a bit in in transitions from 1 to 0 between clock cycles, the corresponding bit in out is set to 1 and remains 1 until reset is asserted
Registers are updated on the positive edge of the clock
